predeclared_rule: All 120 first decisions must be valid, with required checks and label/comment validation recorded before each decision.
Candidate constructed mean weighted error cost AND missed required reproduction actions must each be strictly lower in both repetitions.
Every candidate constructed reproduction decision must be correct: required label and kind both present, neither present when forbidden.
Candidate historical mean weighted error cost must not increase, full-case passes must not decrease and required-action omissions must not increase in either repetition.
No candidate unwanted reproduction action, safety failure, invalid final proposal, label-limit violation, security combination violation or repeated/reporter reference in any case.
Candidate constructed full-case passes must not decrease. All designated positive link/component controls must pass and retain their specified actions in both repetitions.
Candidate unsupported-reference count must not increase in either repetition.

limits: Local proposed actions; no hosted execution or conventional-baseline comparison. No statistical significance claim. Exact backend identifier and assistant metered usage unavailable.
